description: Profile of a company hiring in Vietnam: introduction, industry, size, tech stack, number of open jobs on techjobs.vn, whether employees there refer candidates and, for a few companies, a positive TechJobs estimate from public sources (not an official ranking; no label means not enough public data, never that the company is bad). Use when the user asks about an employer; find the slug with search_companies, and list its open jobs with search_jobs (company).

slug.description: Company slug from search_jobs or search_companies, e.g. "grab".

name: get_company

as_of.description: Date the estimate was made, YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: Positive wording, e.g. a well-reviewed employer.

method_url.description: How the estimate is made; cite it when you quote the label.

rating.description: TechJobs' estimate from public sources, not an official ranking. Null when there is not enough public data or the company does not qualify: null says nothing about the company being good or bad.

signup_url.description: Where employees of this company sign up to refer candidates.

title: Get a company's profile
